idea-plugin.name: Gruvbox Archipelago
idea-plugin.description:
Gruvbox Archipelago brings the warm, retro-groove palette of Gruvbox to modern JetBrains IDEs, with first-class support for the Islands UI.

Eight themes are included:

  • Archipelago Dark and Archipelago Light — the modern Islands layout with the canonical Gruvbox Medium background.
  • Archipelago Dark Hard and Archipelago Light Hard — the Islands layout with the Hard background.
  • Archipelago Dark Soft and Archipelago Light Soft — the Islands layout with the Soft background.
  • Mainland Dark and Mainland Light — the classic flat layout with the Medium background.

Hard, Medium, and Soft are the three canonical Gruvbox background variants. Medium is the standard default; Hard has the strongest contrast, and Soft is the gentlest.

Based on the editor schemes from Vincent Parizet's MIT-licensed Gruvbox Theme, refreshed for IntelliJ Platform 2025.3+ and the Islands UI, with full UI and editor-scheme coverage across all eight themes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release with eight themes: Islands Archipelago Dark/Light in Hard, Medium, and Soft, plus classic Mainland Dark/Light in Medium.
  • Archipelago Dark/Light use the canonical Gruvbox Medium background by default.
  • Canonical Gruvbox palette across all UI surfaces and six editor schemes.
  • Islands UI support plus classic flat variants.
  • Editor panes, rounded buttons, and inactive tool-window headers follow each variant's own surface.
